findings.consequence: ?server= redirects REST, all three WebSockets and PTT microphone PCM to any origin, with no dev-build gate and no CSP. A crafted link can capture voice queries and serve a fake graph. Mitigated by the visible connection label, the PTT press plus mic permission, and the absence of client credentials.
The LLM answer string has no length bound and is returned even when the reply fails validation; a misbehaving model can push arbitrarily long text to the client. It is never executed.

VC-39 describes model, collab, root manifest and client config through ../project/codescape at codescape 13e056d9. The standalone pin is 58108c0 and VisionClaw's gitlink is e3b76f6. The coverage script misses ../project/codescape paths, so the ledger shows these crates uncited, and the one topic that covers them is at a third revision.

findings.citation: WasmVOWL:package.json:43,46; legacy/Gruntfile.js:177-178; no root Gruntfile at 51a148430190
findings.consequence: Root postinstall and test scripts call grunt with no root Gruntfile. By source reading, root npm install and npm test are broken; only modern/ builds. Not run.
The root image fetches upstream webvowl_1.1.7.war over plain HTTP with no checksum and ships neither this repository's modern explorer nor its legacy source.
The tests README documents npm scripts that do not exist, and the suite points at a root src/ that is absent. Its test claims cannot be reproduced.
VW-04's title promises examples, but it cites no file under examples/.
CI never runs the viewer's browser test (rendering, replay, GLB export), so regressions in the tool that produced the calibration arm model go unnoticed.
